title: Benjamin Franklin and the French Muse lodge
summary: Diana Pasulka tells of Benjamin Franklin and the French Muse lodge, about 18th century at France / Masonic lodge, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: like Benjamin Franklin did you know that they were actually part of a Mason Lodge that was a muse Lodge

plain: Diana Pasulka, a scholar of religion, says on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that Benjamin Franklin, the American founding father, belonged to a lodge of the Freemasons, a fraternal society, in France that was a Muse lodge, named for the Muses of Greek myth. She brings it up while talking about hidden links between religion, secret societies and UFOs.
